posts.community: Kiri Industries: Loan reduction and demand surge
posts.text: As long as the prices are kept low by rumours, inconsistencies, management behaviour, some repeated expectation and disappointment on dividends, etc., insiders have every incentive to increase their stake at lower prices, given the potentially very high value of the company if the project is executed. The only barriers to dilution are VWAP (remaining low due to low prices) for a specified period, the valuation report, and the maximum of two. posts.author: ShrenikBhura
posts.community: Kiri Industries: Loan reduction and demand surge
posts.text: Kudos to all those who voted and there was a significant number who did. There was a pushback expressed explicitly during the AGM by at least 2 shareholders. The management did confirm expectations of an earnings surge due to H-Acid pricing spike. Though the resolution 4 has been passed amongst all the others despite a significant “against” votes, there seem to be errors in the scrutinizer’s report. The resolution 4 has been declared as one in which there is no “interest” of the promoters and thereafter the promoters have voted for the same which constitutes in excess of 74% of the votes cast…
